title: Dry Bulk Shipping - November 10, 2026
summary: Capesize Spot Rates Back Above 30,000 as Seasonality Kicks In - Although Short-term Indicators November has traditionally served as a strong period for dry bulk shipping, the Momentum: Neutral recent recovery in spot rates actually commenced earlier than usual in mid-October, defying historical trends that typically point to late-month softness. Looking ahead, Sentiment: Positive we anticipate sustained strength across the spot market for the remainder of Fundamentals: Neutral November. This bullish momentum is further reflected in the futures curve, where December contracts are once again rallying toward the 40,000 mark and first- quarter pricing remains historically elevated.
